## Changes made from the upstream version

Modified by SkillOffice on 2026-11-06:

- Rewrote the critique framework as numbered steps and kept the first-impression, usability, hierarchy, consistency and accessibility dimensions.
- Output uses the SkillOffice findings format with defined severities instead of colored emoji markers.
- Added brand and design-system consistency checks against the SkillOffice brand profile, and a pointer to `dsn-accessibility-review` for full audits.
- Added `references/heuristics.md`: a usability heuristic checklist written for SkillOffice in its own words, in the spirit of the widely known ten heuristics (no text copied), plus hierarchy and interaction checks.
- Removed the slash-command usage block, the Figma-pull instruction, the connectors note and link, and the "if connectors available" section.
- Added quality checklist, safety and handoff sections.
